dc:title: Wuhan Logs: disclosure events, COVID-19 origins case (draft)
dc:description: One row per disclosure event: when and how a piece of evidence became public, or a documented request that was not met. Process metadata only. Draft schema proposed in research/data-model-proposal.md.

columns.name: id
columns.dc:description: Stable event ID. YYYY is the year of disclosure, or for a non-disclosure the year the unmet request was first publicly documented. NNN is assigned in registration order and never reused.

columns.name: case
columns.dc:description: Case directory name under cases/.

columns.name: event_type
columns.dc:description: disclosure: evidence made public; correction: an earlier public statement amended; non-disclosure: a documented request not met; statement-about-disclosure: a party's public statement about evidence it does not itself release.

columns.name: evidence_described
columns.dc:description: What was (or was not) disclosed, described at the level of documents or data sets, not their content.

columns.name: evidence_holder
columns.dc:description: Party that created or held the evidence before disclosure, as far as documented.

columns.name: releasing_party
columns.dc:description: Party that made the evidence public. Empty for non-disclosure events.

columns.name: channel
columns.dc:description: How the evidence reached the public.

columns.name: acquisition_route
columns.dc:description: How the releasing party obtained the evidence from the holder (for non-disclosures: how it was requested).

columns.name: source_ids
columns.dc:description: Sources in sources/register.json that document the event. Checked against the register by script (CSVW cannot reference a JSON file).

columns.name: evidence_created
columns.dc:description: Date the evidence was created, at the precision known (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Empty if unknown.

columns.name: date_requested
columns.dc:description: Date of the first documented request for the evidence, if any.

columns.name: date_disclosed
columns.dc:description: Date the evidence became public. Read together with date_disclosed_qualifier.

columns.name: lag_days
columns.dc:description: Days from evidence_created to date_disclosed. Filled only when both are day-precision and the qualifier is 'on'; never estimated.

columns.name: resistance
columns.dc:description: Documented resistance by the holder. 'none-recorded' is a bounded statement, not proof of none.

columns.name: release_claim
columns.dc:description: What the releasing party said about novelty or completeness, with source.

columns.name: related_event_ids
columns.dc:description: Events releasing overlapping evidence, or responding to this one.

columns.name: claim_ids
columns.dc:description: Transitional back-reference to data/claims.csv; to be dropped once claims carry disclosure_ids.

columns.name: finding_ids
columns.dc:description: Transitional back-reference to cases/covid-origins/findings.csv; to be dropped once findings carry disclosure_ids.

columns.name: control_ids
columns.dc:description: Controls in framework/controls.csv engaged by the event (the CWE-like weakness classes).

columns.name: notes
columns.dc:description: Unknowns and caveats. Every empty field that matters should be explained here.
